label: paracetamol 1000 mg oral (Coldrex MaxGrip combination), semi-fed, n=11
note: GSK study E3870651 (NCT01551836), clinical study result summary p.2, Coldrex MaxGrip column. A marketed combination (paracetamol 1000 mg, phenylephrine 10 mg, ascorbic acid 40 mg; dosage form not stated) taken about 2.5 h after a standard breakfast, sampled only to 3 h: it does not test fasted Cmax or the terminal phase, and its peak (10.1 ug/mL) sits well below fasted tablet data. Kept for its dense early sampling (1-11 min): 3 of 11 subjects were above the 0.5 ug/mL LLOQ at 3 min. Times were printed in minutes. Below-LLOQ samples entered the printed means as zero, so the earliest and latest means run low.
